title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
大楚王朝。天玄宗，演武场。烈日当空，炙烤着大地，演武场上的青石板被晒得发烫。然而。天玄宗的外门弟子们却丝毫没有松懈，一个个挥汗如雨。拳风呼啸，剑光闪烁。空气中弥漫着汗水的咸湿味。“呼——哈——”整齐的呼喝声此起彼伏，弟子们的衣衫早已被汗水浸透，紧贴在身上。但他们依旧在咬牙坚持，目光坚如磐石，仿佛要将自己身体里最后一丝力气都榨干才算罢休。外门长老杜青峰站在演武场的高台上，目光扫过场中的弟子，脸上露出一丝满意的笑容。他捋了捋虎须，心中暗自点头：“不错，今年的这批外门弟子倒是有些毅力。”然而。就在他心情愉悦之际，耳畔突然传来一阵不合时宜的悠闲声音。“少爷，您的酸梅汤来了！”“是冰镇的吗？”“嗯，冰了足足三个时辰呢。”“哇！真爽！”杜青峰眉头一皱，循声望去，只见演武场边缘的树荫下，一个年轻人正懒洋洋地躺在一把躺椅上，翘着二郎腿，手里捧着一碗冰镇酸梅汤，悠哉悠哉地喝着。旁边还有一个书童模样的少年，殷勤地为他扇着扇子。杜青峰的脸色瞬间沉了下来，额角的青筋微微跳动。他认得这个年轻人。陈轩！天玄宗前任大长老陈洪的独子。十年前。陈洪一人独战九大宗门的宗师高手，为天玄宗夺下了天级灵矿，立下了赫赫战功。然而，回到宗门之后，却因为伤重，主动辞去了宗门大长老的职务，黯然隐退。临走之前，他将自己的独子陈轩托付给了宗门，希望宗门能够好生照料。身为陈洪的儿子，七岁的陈轩被视为天玄宗的未来。然而，命运弄人。在两年前，在天玄宗的灵根检测中，十七岁的陈轩，灵根竟然被判定为废品。这下，他直接从云端跌落到谷底，沦为了宗门内的笑柄。陈洪的好友，宗门刑天大长老朱跃升得知此事，倾尽全力去寻找修复灵根的方法。可谁也没有想到的是，陈轩自己却突然放弃了。“不用麻烦了，我去当个外门弟子就挺好。”

丢下这句话后，陈轩便搬到了外门。从此，他就过上了躺平摆烂的日子，整日吃喝玩乐，游手好闲，俨然一副败家子的做派。“陈轩，你要摆烂到什么时候？”杜青峰忍无可忍，大步走到陈轩面前，声音中带着压抑的愤怒。“呦！是杜长老啊！”陈轩懒洋洋地抬了抬眼皮，脸上挂着漫不经心的笑容，“杜长老，快来，我这刚到的酸梅汤，酸甜冰凉，解暑润喉，你也来尝尝。”说着，他朝着身边的小童挥了挥手，示意他给杜青峰端一碗过去。“陈轩——”杜青峰气得脸色铁青，刚刚捋顺的胡须都在颤抖。“啪！”他一巴掌打翻了小童手中的酸梅汤。清脆的瓷器碎裂声在演武场上响起，弟子们的目光纷纷被吸引过来，场中修炼声也渐渐停了下来。“杜长老，你这是何必呢？”陈轩啧了一声，摇了摇头，看着地上打翻的冰镇酸梅汤，他一脸惋惜，“就算不喜欢，也不能糟蹋啊。”“陈轩，你看看你现在的样子！”杜青峰指着陈轩，声音中满是恨铁不成钢的怒意，“你父亲当年是何等英雄，你怎么能如此自甘堕落？”“杜长老生气了！”“能不生气吗？那小子太过分了，仗着自己是前任大长老的独子，整天无所事事，游手好闲！咱们天玄宗的脸都被他给丢尽了！”演武场上的弟子们看到这一幕，窃窃私语。刺耳的嘲笑声传进了陈轩和杜青峰的耳中。“你听听！看看同门是怎么看你的！”杜青峰咬牙切齿地说道。然而。陈轩却依旧一脸淡然，轻飘飘地挑了挑眉，“他们那是嫉妒。”此言一出。演武场上的外门弟子们瞬间炸开了锅。“什么？嫉妒？我们嫉妒你？”“我们嫉妒你什么？嫉妒你躺平摆烂？”“要不是你爹的那点功劳，你现在早就被逐出宗门了！”唰唰唰！说话间，一道道愤怒的目光如同利箭般射向陈轩。“好了，都闭嘴！”杜青峰大喝一声，场中顿时安静下来。

The Chu Dynasty.Tianxuanzong, martial arts field.The scorching sun was in the sky, scorching the earth, and the bluestone slabs on the martial arts field were heated by the sun.However.However, the outer disciples of Tianxuan Sect did not relax at all, and they were all sweating profusely.The fist wind roared and the sword light flashed.The air was filled with the salty smell of sweat."Hu-ha-" neat shouts came and went, and the disciples' clothes were already soaked with sweat and clung to their bodies.But they still gritted their teeth and persisted, their eyes as solid as rock, as if they wanted to squeeze out the last bit of strength from their bodies before giving up.Du Qingfeng, the elder of the outer sect, stood on the high platform of the martial arts arena, scanning the disciples in the arena with a satisfied smile on his face.He stroked his beard and nodded secretly in his mind: "Yes, this year's group of outer disciples have some perseverance." However.Just when he was in a happy mood, an inappropriate and leisurely sound suddenly came from his ears."Master, your sour plum soup is here!" "Is it iced?" "Well, it has been chilled for three hours." "Wow! It feels so good!" Du Qingfeng frowned and looked around. He saw a young man lying lazily on a recliner under the shade of a tree at the edge of the martial arts arena, with his legs crossed and a bowl of iced sour plum soup in his hand, drinking leisurely.There was a boy who looked like a book boy next to him, fanning him diligently.Du Qingfeng's face instantly darkened, and the veins on his forehead twitched slightly.He recognized this young man.Chen Xuan!The only son of Chen Hong, the former great elder of Tianxuan Sect.ten years ago.Chen Hong single-handedly fought against the masters of the nine major sects, and won the heaven-level spiritual mine for Tianxuan Sect, making great achievements in battle.However, after returning to the sect, due to serious injuries, he voluntarily resigned from his position as the sect's chief elder and retired sadly.Before leaving, he entrusted his only son Chen Xuan to the sect, hoping that the sect would take good care of him.As the son of Chen Hong, seven-year-old Chen Xuan is regarded as the future of Tianxuan Sect.However, fate plays tricks on people.Two years ago, in the Tianxuan Sect's spiritual root test, the spiritual root of seventeen-year-old Chen Xuan was judged to be useless.At this time, he fell directly from the clouds to the bottom of the valley and became the laughing stock of the sect.Chen Hong's friend Zhu Yuesheng, the sect's Xingtian Grand Elder, learned about this and tried his best to find a way to repair his spiritual roots.But what no one expected was that Chen Xuan himself suddenly gave up."Don't bother, I'll be fine just being an outer disciple."

After saying these words, Chen Xuan moved to the outer door.From then on, he lived a life of lying around, eating, drinking, having fun, and doing nothing, just like a prodigal."Chen Xuan, how long are you going to keep showing off?" Du Qingfeng couldn't bear it anymore and strode up to Chen Xuan with suppressed anger in his voice."Hey! It's Elder Du!" Chen Xuan lazily raised his eyelids, with a careless smile on his face, "Elder Du, come on, I have just arrived the sour plum soup, it is sour, sweet and cold, it relieves summer heat and soothes the throat. Come and try it." As he said, he waved to the child beside him, indicating that he would bring a bowl to Du Qingfeng."Chen Xuan——" Du Qingfeng's face turned livid with anger, and the beard he had just smoothed was trembling."Pah!" He slapped the sour plum soup in the child's hand.The crisp sound of breaking porcelain sounded in the martial arts field. The disciples' eyes were attracted one after another, and the sound of practicing in the field gradually stopped."Elder Du, why are you doing this?" Chen Xuan clicked his tongue, shook his head, and looked at the ice-cold sour plum soup spilled on the ground, with a look of regret on his face, "Even if you don't like it, you can't waste it." "Chen Xuan, look at what you look like now!" Du Qingfeng pointed at Chen Xuan, his voice full of anger, "Your father used to hate iron.What a hero, how can you be so willing to fall for yourself?"" Elder Du is angry!" "Can you not be angry?That kid is too much. He is doing nothing all day long!He has embarrassed our Tianxuan Sect!" The disciples in the martial arts field murmured when they saw this scene.Harsh ridicule reached the ears of Chen Xuan and Du Qingfeng."Listen! See what your fellow disciples think of you!" Du Qingfeng said through gritted teeth.However.Chen Xuan still looked indifferent and raised his eyebrows lightly, "They are jealous." As soon as he said this.The outer disciples on the martial arts field instantly exploded."What? Jealousy? Are we jealous of you?" "Why are we jealous of you? Jealous of you lying flat and dying?" "If it weren't for your father's contribution, you would have been expelled from the sect by now!" Swish!As he spoke, angry glances shot towards Chen Xuan like sharp arrows."Okay, shut up!" Du Qingfeng shouted, and the place suddenly became quiet.
